description: Sync every story and epic in the Shortcut workspace your token can read. Shortcut permissions are not imported.
opening: Sync every story and epic in the Shortcut workspace the token can read. There is nothing to select. Each story and each epic is one document with its description. A story links to its epic and to its parent story.

Shortcut permissions are not imported, so every synced item is visible to everyone who can query the collection unless you set an access rule. Comments, tasks, files, owners and requesters are not synced, and a story's workflow state is kept only as a number. Stories and epics deleted in Shortcut stay in HydraDB.

notes: No per-team or per-story visibility is captured. To restrict the whole connector, set an access rule on its resource.

steps.title: Create an API token
steps.text: In Shortcut, create an API token.

steps.title: Configure the connector
steps.text: There is nothing to select. The connector syncs every story and epic the token can read.

connect.account: One connector reads the Shortcut workspace one token can read.

sync.first_sync: Reads back the window set by `lookback_days`, 30 days by default, measured on when stories and epics were last updated.
sync.changes: Each sync reads the stories and epics updated since the last sync. A story found both in the workspace and in a legacy Project is stored once.
sync.edits: An edited story or epic is picked up through its last-updated time and updates its document.
sync.deletes: Stories and epics deleted in Shortcut stay searchable in HydraDB.

shared_attributes.name: connector_id
shared_attributes.text: Limits a query to this connector's items. Not searchable.

documents.name: Stories
documents.one_document: One Shortcut story, including stories in legacy Projects.
documents.title: The story name, or `Shortcut story` and its id when the name is empty.
documents.text: The story description. The labels, the creation date and the story id are written as lines too. The title is searchable too.
documents.date: When the story was last updated, or when it was created if there is no update time.

attributes.name: Story id
attributes.text: The Shortcut story id. It keeps later syncs on the same document.

attributes.name: labels
attributes.text: Label names, written as the `Labels` line.

attributes.name: created_at
attributes.text: When the story was created, written as the `Created` line.

attributes.name: updated_at
attributes.text: When the story was last updated. Sets the result date and decides when a sync picks the story up. Not searchable.

attributes.name: epic_id
attributes.text: The epic the story belongs to. Links the story to that epic. Not searchable.

attributes.name: parent_story_id
attributes.text: The story this story is a sub-task of. Links the story to that parent. Not searchable.

attributes.name: additional_metadata.shortcut_id
attributes.text: The story id. Picks out one story. Not searchable.

attributes.name: story_type
attributes.text: `feature`, `bug` or `chore`. It is not written into the text.

attributes.name: workflow_state
attributes.text: The workflow state's numeric id, not its name.

attributes.name: project_id
attributes.text: The legacy Project id, often empty.

documents.name: Epics
documents.title: The epic name, or `Shortcut epic` and its id when the name is empty.
documents.text: The epic description. The creation date and the epic id are written as lines too. The title is searchable too.
documents.date: When the epic was last updated, or when it was created if there is no update time.

attributes.name: Epic id
attributes.text: `epic:` and the epic id, so it never clashes with a story id. Stories link to this id.

attributes.name: created_at
attributes.text: When the epic was created, written as the `Created` line.

attributes.name: updated_at
attributes.text: When the epic was last updated. Sets the result date and decides when a sync picks the epic up. Not searchable.

attributes.name: additional_metadata.shortcut_id
attributes.text: The epic id, without the `epic:` prefix. Picks out one epic. Not searchable.

attributes.name: additional_metadata.shortcut_kind
attributes.text: Always `epic`. Limits a query to epics. Not searchable.

attributes.name: state
attributes.text: `to do`, `in progress` or `done`. It is not written into the text.

connections: A story to its parent story.
No links to items in other tools.
graph.people: No people are attached to stories or epics. Owners, requesters and followers are not synced.

not_synced: Story comments, tasks (checklists), files and linked files.
Readable workflow state names. Only the state's numeric id is kept.
Members, labels, milestones, iterations, categories, objectives and groups as items of their own.
